sentences.english: I'm so sorry about that.
sentences.chinese: 那件事我真的很抱歉。
sentences.scene: 向朋友道歉

sentences.english: I'm really sorry I forgot your birthday—I feel terrible about it.
sentences.chinese: 真对不起我忘了你的生日，我特别过意不去。
sentences.scene: 忘记朋友生日后真诚道歉

sentences.english: I wanted to say sorry for being late yesterday; I got stuck in traffic and my phone died so I couldn't call you.
sentences.chinese: 我想为昨天迟到道歉，我遇上堵车手机又没电了，没法给你打电话。
sentences.scene: 解释迟到原因并道歉

sentences.english: Hurry up, we are late!
sentences.chinese: 快点，我们迟到了！
sentences.scene: 催促同伴赶紧出门

sentences.english: Can you hurry up in the bathroom? I really need to get ready too.
sentences.chinese: 你能快点用完卫生间吗？我也急着要梳洗呢。
sentences.scene: 早上和家人共用卫生间时催促

sentences.english: If we don't hurry up and buy the tickets now, they might sell out and we'll miss the concert.
sentences.chinese: 如果我们不赶快现在买票，票可能会卖光，我们就错过演唱会了。
sentences.scene: 提醒朋友抢票要快

sentences.english: Don't be late for school.
sentences.chinese: 上学别迟到。
sentences.scene: 家长早上叮嘱孩子

sentences.english: I stayed up too late watching movies and now I'm exhausted.
sentences.chinese: 我看电影熬夜到太晚，现在困死了。
sentences.scene: 抱怨熬夜的后遗症

sentences.english: Even though I left early, I was still late for the meeting because there was an accident on the highway.
sentences.chinese: 尽管我出门很早，但因为高速上出了事故，我开会还是迟到了。
sentences.scene: 解释不可抗力导致的迟到

sentences.english: I have math class now.
sentences.chinese: 我现在有数学课。
sentences.scene: 告诉同学自己的课表

sentences.english: Our class is going on a field trip to the science museum next week.
sentences.chinese: 我们班下周要去科学博物馆实地考察。
sentences.scene: 兴奋地分享班级活动

sentences.english: The best part of that class was when the teacher let us work in groups and we could actually talk.
sentences.chinese: 那堂课最棒的部分就是老师让我们分组合作，我们终于可以说说话了。
sentences.scene: 回忆一堂有趣的小组讨论课

sentences.english: Are you ready to go?
sentences.chinese: 你准备好走了吗？
sentences.scene: 出门前询问同伴

sentences.english: Dinner will be ready in about ten minutes, so please set the table.
sentences.chinese: 晚饭大概十分钟后好，请摆一下桌子。
sentences.scene: 家长叫孩子帮忙准备开饭

sentences.english: I thought I was ready for the exam, but when I saw the first question, my mind went completely blank.
sentences.chinese: 我以为我考试准备得很好了，但看到第一道题时，脑子瞬间一片空白。
sentences.scene: 考场上过度紧张的经历

sentences.english: Running is not allowed at school. It is a school rule.
sentences.chinese: 不准奔跑是学校的规定。
sentences.scene: 老师提醒学生遵守校规

sentences.english: My parents have a rule that I have to finish my homework before I can play video games.
sentences.chinese: 我爸妈规定我必须先做完作业才能玩电子游戏。
sentences.scene: 向朋友吐槽家规

sentences.english: One important rule in our house is that we all eat dinner together without any phones at the table.
sentences.chinese: 我们家一条重要的规矩是大家要一起吃晚饭，饭桌上不许看手机。
sentences.scene: 介绍自己家的温馨家规

sentences.english: The classroom is very quiet.
sentences.chinese: 教室非常安静。
sentences.scene: 进入自习室时的观察

sentences.english: We decorated the classroom for the holiday party with balloons and streamers.
sentences.chinese: 我们为节日派对用气球和彩带装饰了教室。
sentences.scene: 布置教室迎接节日

sentences.english: I forgot my textbook in the classroom, so I had to go back to school after everyone had already left.
sentences.chinese: 我把课本忘在教室里了，只好在大家都走后回学校去拿。
sentences.scene: 放学后忘东西跑回教室

sentences.english: Please turn off the lights.
sentences.chinese: 请把灯关掉。
sentences.scene: 离开房间时提醒关灯

sentences.english: Can you turn off the TV? I'm trying to study and it's distracting me.
sentences.chinese: 你能把电视关掉吗？我在学习，它让我分心。
sentences.scene: 学习时被电视声打扰

sentences.english: Before we go to bed, I always double-check that I turned off the stove and locked the doors.
sentences.chinese: 睡觉前，我总是会反复检查我关了炉子、锁了门没有。
sentences.scene: 睡前安全检查的习惯

sentences.english: Turn on the light, please.
sentences.chinese: 请开一下灯。
sentences.scene: 天黑时请人帮忙开灯

sentences.english: The light in the hallway flickers sometimes, so the bulb probably needs to be replaced.
sentences.chinese: 走廊的灯有时会闪，灯泡可能该换了。
sentences.scene: 提醒家人换灯泡

sentences.english: I love the soft morning light that comes through my bedroom window; it makes waking up much easier.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢清晨透过卧室窗户洒进来的柔和光线，这让起床变得容易多了。
sentences.scene: 享受早晨的自然光

sentences.english: Write your name on the blackboard.
sentences.chinese: 把你的名字写在黑板上。
sentences.scene: 老师让学生到黑板前写名字

sentences.english: The teacher wrote today's homework on the blackboard before the bell rang.
sentences.chinese: 老师在下课铃响前把今天的作业写在了黑板上。
sentences.scene: 下课前的教室场景

sentences.english: When I was in elementary school, my favorite job was cleaning the blackboard after class with the erasers.
sentences.chinese: 我上小学时，最喜欢干的事就是课后用板擦清理黑板。
sentences.scene: 回忆童年当值日生的乐趣

sentences.english: My desk is a mess.
sentences.chinese: 我的书桌一团糟。
sentences.scene: 看到凌乱书桌时的感慨

sentences.english: I keep a picture of my family on my desk so I can see them while I work.
sentences.chinese: 我在书桌上放了张全家福，这样工作的时候就能看到他们。
sentences.scene: 介绍自己办公桌上的温馨摆设

sentences.english: I found a note from my little sister tucked under my desk lamp saying I love you, and it made my day.
sentences.chinese: 我在台灯下发现妹妹塞的一张纸条，上面写着“我爱你”，那让我一整天都很开心。
sentences.scene: 意外收到家人暖心小纸条

sentences.english: Pull up a chair and sit down.
sentences.chinese: 拉把椅子过来坐下。
sentences.scene: 热情招呼客人入座

sentences.english: I need a new office chair because my back hurts after sitting all day.
sentences.chinese: 我需要一把新的办公椅，坐一整天我背很疼。
sentences.scene: 考虑更换不舒服的办公椅

sentences.english: We had to bring extra chairs from the basement when more guests showed up than we expected.
sentences.chinese: 来的客人比我们预想的多，我们只好从地下室搬来额外的椅子。
sentences.scene: 家庭聚会时人多椅子不够

sentences.english: Your room looks very tidy.
sentences.chinese: 你的房间看起来很整洁。
sentences.scene: 妈妈夸奖孩子房间干净

sentences.english: I need to tidy up the living room before our guests arrive.
sentences.chinese: 我得在客人来之前把客厅整理一下。
sentences.scene: 客人到访前的匆忙收拾

sentences.english: I always feel so much more relaxed and focused when my desk is tidy and everything is in its place.
sentences.chinese: 当书桌整整齐齐、所有东西各就各位时，我总是觉得更放松也更专注。
sentences.scene: 分享整洁环境带来的好状态

sentences.english: I love listening to music.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢听音乐。
sentences.scene: 表达对音乐的喜爱

sentences.english: Can you turn the music down a little? I'm on the phone.
sentences.chinese: 你能把音乐关小声一点吗？我在打电话。
sentences.scene: 接电话时请人调低音量

sentences.english: Putting on my favorite music while I cook dinner turns a boring chore into something I actually look forward to.
sentences.chinese: 做晚饭时放上我最喜欢的音乐，能把无聊的家务变成我真正期待的事情。
sentences.scene: 边听音乐边做饭的享受

sentences.english: Close the door, it's cold.
sentences.chinese: 关上门，好冷。
sentences.scene: 冬天提醒家人关门保暖

sentences.english: Someone knocked on the door, but when I opened it, nobody was there.
sentences.chinese: 有人敲门，但等我打开门，外面却没人。
sentences.scene: 遇到恶作剧按门铃的奇怪经历

sentences.english: I always leave my keys by the door so I don't panic looking for them when I'm already late.
sentences.chinese: 我总把钥匙放在门边，这样即便已经迟到了，也不会因为找钥匙而抓狂。
sentences.scene: 养成固定放钥匙的习惯

sentences.english: Open the window. It's stuffy.
sentences.chinese: 把窗户打开，太闷了。
sentences.scene: 房间里闷热时请求通风

sentences.english: I like to sit by the window on the bus and watch the city go by.
sentences.chinese: 坐公交车时我喜欢靠窗坐，看着城市从眼前掠过。
sentences.scene: 描述乘公交时的小喜好

sentences.english: During the storm, the wind was so strong that a tree branch broke our living room window.
sentences.chinese: 暴风雨时风太大了，一根树枝把我们家客厅的窗户打破了。
sentences.scene: 讲述暴风雨造成的意外破坏

sentences.english: Turn on the fan, it's hot.
sentences.chinese: 开风扇吧，好热。
sentences.scene: 夏天在家热得受不了

sentences.english: I'm a huge fan of that band, and I've been to five of their concerts.
sentences.chinese: 我是那个乐队的铁杆粉丝，我去过他们五场演唱会了。
sentences.scene: 表达对乐队的狂热喜爱

sentences.english: The ceiling fan in my bedroom makes a clicking noise all night, but I've gotten so used to it that I can't sleep without it.
sentences.chinese: 我卧室的吊扇整晚咔嗒作响，但我早就习惯了，没有这声音反而睡不着。
sentences.scene: 习惯了风扇噪音的独特助眠方式

sentences.english: When does the movie start?
sentences.chinese: 电影什么时候开始？
sentences.scene: 和朋友确认电影开场时间

sentences.english: I was about to leave the house when I realized I forgot my wallet.
sentences.chinese: 我刚要出门，突然发现忘带钱包了。
sentences.scene: 临出门时发现忘带重要物品

sentences.english: When I look back at my childhood photos, I remember how much fun we had just playing in the backyard.
sentences.chinese: 当我翻看童年照片时，就想起我们在后院玩耍时有多开心。
sentences.scene: 翻看老照片引发美好回忆

sentences.english: I don't understand this question.
sentences.chinese: 我不懂这个问题。
sentences.scene: 做作业时向人求助

sentences.english: Could you please repeat that? I didn't quite understand what you said.
sentences.chinese: 你能重复一遍吗？我没太听明白你说的话。
sentences.scene: 没听清对方讲话时礼貌请求

sentences.english: It took me a long time to understand why my parents were so strict, but now I realize they just wanted to protect me.
sentences.chinese: 我花了很长时间才理解为什么爸妈那么严格，现在我明白了他们只是想保护我。
sentences.scene: 长大后对父母严厉教育的感悟

sentences.english: There's a picture on the wall.
sentences.chinese: 墙上有一幅画。
sentences.scene: 向人介绍房间装饰

sentences.english: We painted the kitchen wall light yellow to make the room feel brighter.
sentences.chinese: 我们把厨房的墙刷成了浅黄色，让房间感觉更明亮。
sentences.scene: 家庭装修后的分享

sentences.english: The walls in our apartment are so thin that I can hear my neighbors talking as if they're in the same room.
sentences.chinese: 我们公寓的墙薄得不行，我能听到邻居说话，就像他们在同一个房间里似的。
sentences.scene: 抱怨公寓隔音太差

sentences.english: My dad reads the newspaper every morning.
sentences.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上看报纸。
sentences.scene: 描述爸爸的晨间习惯

sentences.english: I saw your photo in the local newspaper for winning the spelling competition!
sentences.chinese: 我在本地报纸上看到你赢了拼字比赛的照片了！
sentences.scene: 朋友在报上看到熟人照片很惊喜

sentences.english: Even though most people get their news online, my grandfather still walks to the corner store every Sunday to buy the newspaper.
sentences.chinese: 虽然大多数人都在网上看新闻，但我爷爷还是每个星期天都走到街角商店去买报纸。
sentences.scene: 老一辈坚持传统读报习惯

sentences.english: Please hand out these papers.
sentences.chinese: 请把这些卷子发下去。
sentences.scene: 老师请学生帮忙发资料

sentences.english: The teacher asked me to hand out the test sheets while she set up the projector.
sentences.chinese: 老师让我在她调投影仪的时候把试卷发下去。
sentences.scene: 帮忙发考卷的课堂日常

sentences.english: At the end of the party, we handed out little gift bags to all the kids as they left with their parents.
sentences.chinese: 派对结束时，孩子们跟着家长离开时，我们给所有小孩分发了小礼品袋。
sentences.scene: 派对结束后分发伴手礼

sentences.english: Open your workbook to page 20.
sentences.chinese: 把练习册翻到第20页。
sentences.scene: 老师在课堂上指示

sentences.english: I finished all the math problems in my workbook before class ended.
sentences.chinese: 我在下课之前做完了练习册上所有的数学题。
sentences.scene: 高效完成课堂作业

sentences.english: My handwriting was so messy in my workbook that the teacher wrote a note asking me to slow down and write more neatly.
sentences.chinese: 我练习册上的字迹太潦草了，老师写了条评语让我放慢速度、写工整些。
sentences.scene: 老师对作业书写提出要求
